source.title: Some open problems in p-adic analysis

trace.notes: Normalized one URL input. Direct fetch of https://zbmath.org/4158774 returned a Cloudflare challenge/403, so zbMATH was treated as a resolver rather than a readable technical source.

zbMATH REST API identified document 4158774, Zbl 0706.12007, as V. K. Srinivasan, Some open problems in p-adic analysis, in Proceedings of the Ramanujan Centenary International Conference, Annamalainagar, India 1987, RMS Publications 1, pages 159-160, 1988.

The zbMATH API record includes reviewer summary text listing three problems, but this was not used as the technical extraction source because the workflow treats zbMATH records as resolver metadata and forbids extracting from bibliographic metadata or reviews when the primary source is unavailable.

Bounded exact-work recovery searched for the exact title, the exact title plus PDF, the exact title plus author, the proceedings title, ISBN 9788190007207, OCLC 27143645, and HathiTrust item mdp.39015019565954. Google Books confirmed page 159 only through snippets and bibliographic metadata; HathiTrust reported the University of Michigan copy as Limited (search-only); no direct PDF or readable full-text HTML artifact was recovered.

Failure mode: blocked_or_challenged for the original zbMATH page, followed by metadata_only and search-snippet-only recovery candidates. Input could not be normalized to a readable PDF or HTML full-text source for extraction without relying on resolver records, bibliographic reviews, or search snippets.
Saved exact JSON payload to outputs/parse-paper/4158774.json and outputs/latest.json.
